subject.title: fix(memory-core): defer dreaming sweep when main session has active runs

question: Should the permanent contract be a core-owned background admission/yield seam, or a raw process-wide active-run count exposed to plugins?
rationale: The PR expands a compatibility-sensitive plugin API while explicitly leaving the overlap race open, so the correct ownership and accepted semantics require maintainer intent.

options.title: Core admission seam
options.body: Expose a bounded scheduler-owned primitive and apply it for the entire dreaming sweep.

options.title: Accept raw count
options.body: Support best-effort plugin-local deferral with explicit acceptance of residual overlap and starvation risk.

recommendation.title: Core admission seam
recommendation.body: Expose a bounded scheduler-owned primitive and apply it for the entire dreaming sweep.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work covers the runner-state and session-fence boundaries that should own or review this concurrency contract.
